title: Web3it.ai 🚀
tagline: No-code Web3+AI Agent as a Service powered, type in your existing Web2 product idea and instantly convert it to a Web3+AI product.
description:
Web3it.ai is built with a goal of helping millions of talented developers around the world access the power of Web3 and AI in one click. 

Web2 developers can simply share their existing product idea or a new idea and Web3it instantly tokenizes the product and fair launches it on a bonding curve. Web3it also launches an AI Marketing agent and an AI Dev agent that infuses their Web2 product (now Web3) with powerful AI capabilities - all out of the box.
how_its_made:
1.⁠ ⁠The idea is converted into a Web3 idea, logo and landing page generated using our custom Web3 AI built on top of Claude.

2.⁠ ⁠Tokenization of the product and bonding curve launch is implemented on the Arbitrum Network. Privy is used for user authentication. 

3.⁠ ⁠The AI agent is built on top of Eliza with a strong focus on Twitter.

4.⁠ ⁠The Dev Agent is built on top of Srcbook.
